month_notes: November is the first month Noi Bai runs entirely on the winter timetable, and it lands heavier than October. Korean Air has swapped both Seoul rotations from A321neos to an A330-300 and a 777-300ER, Air China added a second Beijing flight that touches down at 03:00, IndiGo started daily Mumbai, and Vietnam Airlines opened Ahmedabad on the 3rd. Hanoi’s cool dry season also puts European, Gulf and Indian traffic at its autumn peak — 126 international arrivals a day against 120 in October, and 26,838 seats against 25,413.
empty_band_note: Quieter, but Noi Bai never fully empties — fourteen flights still land overnight, Air China’s new 03:00 Beijing arrival among them

context.text: Terminal 2 reopened in expanded form on 19 December 2025 at 200,164 m², lifting capacity from 10 to 15 million passengers a year. Immigration handles roughly 44,000–45,000 arrivals and departures a day, and since 3 August 2026 foreign passport holders have had their own lane. November is the first full month on the IATA winter schedule that took effect on 25 October 2026.
context.source: Bao Chinh phu and Tuoi Tre, August 2026; Noi Bai T2 expansion, December 2025; IATA winter 2026/27 timetable from 25 October 2026

basis: based on flight schedules and official airport data from 2025–2026
